title: Species Plate: Reactio perpetua
object: Archival pigment print, 11 x 14 in, hand-numbered edition of 300. Original illustration.
wall_label: Drawn in the naturalist tradition. Specimen shown at rest and mid-transmission, with anatomical callouts to the compression artefact, the cropped watermark, and the vestigial context lobe. The lobe is non-functional in all observed adults.

notes.Provenance: Commissioned by the museum, 2026. Illustrator credited on verso.

shop_copy: Framed, this passes for a real natural history print until someone reads it.
